# Elevation Raster
```{r}
elev <- rast("analysis/environment/CA_elevation.tif")
```

White Mountain:
37.634902, -118.255386
Piute Pass:
37.223629, -118.687127
```{r}
points <- data.frame(lon = c(-118.255386, -118.687127), lat = c(37.634902, 37.223629))
pnts <- vect(points, geom = c("lon", "lat"), crs = "EPSG:4326")

# Now project to match the raster CRS (EPSG:3857)
line <- project(as.lines(pnts), elev)

# Plot to confirm alignment
plot(elev)
lines(line, col = "red", lwd = 2)

transect <- terra::extractAlong(elev, line)

transect_df <- as.data.frame(transect[[2]]) # second element is the list/matrix
transect_df$distance_m <- seq(0, nrow(transect_df)-1) * res(elev)[1]  # approximate distance if regular
names(transect_df) <- c("elevation", "distance_m")

# Convert distance to km
transect_df$distance_km <- transect_df$distance_m / 1000

# ggplot elevation profile
ggplot(transect_df, aes(x = distance_km, y = elevation)) +
  geom_line(color = "sienna4", linewidth = 1) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    x = "Distance (km)",
    y = "Elevation (m)",
    title = "Elevation Transect between Sierra Nevada and White Mountains"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

```
Trying to extend the lines out a bit
```{r}
bearing <- geosphere::bearing(pnts[1,], pnts[2,])
dist <- geosphere::distGeo(pnts[1,], pnts[2,])

# Extend by 5 km (5000 m) in both directions
start_ext <- geosphere::destPoint(pnts[1,], bearing - 180, 5000)
end_ext   <- geosphere::destPoint(pnts[2,], bearing, 5000)

# Combine extended points
extended_points <- rbind(start_ext, end_ext)
extended <- vect(as.data.frame(extended_points), geom = c("lon", "lat"), crs = "EPSG:4326")

# Create a line and project to match your DEM
line_extended <- as.lines(extended)
line_extended <- project(line_extended, elev)

# Check visually
plot(elev)
lines(line_extended, col="red", lwd=2)

transect.ext <- terra::extractAlong(elev, line_extended)

transect.ext_df <- as.data.frame(transect.ext[[2]]) # second element is the list/matrix
transect.ext_df$distance_m <- seq(0, nrow(transect.ext_df)-1) * res(elev)[1]  # approximate distance if regular
names(transect.ext_df) <- c("elevation", "distance_m")

# Convert distance to km
transect.ext_df$distance_km <- transect.ext_df$distance_m / 1000

# ggplot elevation profile
ggplot(transect.ext_df, aes(x = distance_km, y = elevation)) +
  geom_line(color = "sienna4", linewidth = 1) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    x = "Distance (km)",
    y = "Elevation (m)",
    title = "Elevation Transect between Sierra Nevada and White Mountains"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

```

# higher resolution elevation data...

```{r}
file_list <- list.files(path="analysis/environment/high_res_elev/", pattern="*.tif", all.files=TRUE, full.names=TRUE)

allrasters <- lapply(file_list, rast)
plot(allrasters[[1]])

allrasters <- list()

for (i in seq_along(file_list)) {
   # Process each raster
   raster <- rast(file_list[i])

   # Aggregate the raster
   aggregated_raster <- terra::aggregate(raster, 5)

   # Store the aggregated raster
   allrasters[[i]] <- aggregated_raster

   # Print the name of the file once the aggregation is done
   print(paste("Completed aggregation for:", basename(file_list[i])))
 }

merged <- do.call(merge, allrasters)

writeRaster(merged, "analysis/environment/raw_GCRF_working_area_elev.tif")
```

Plot again.
```{r}
line_extended <- project(line_extended, merged)

# Check visually
plot(merged)
lines(line_extended, col="red", lwd=2)

transect.ext <- terra::extractAlong(merged, line_extended)

transect.ext_df <- as.data.frame(transect.ext[[2]]) # second element is the list/matrix
transect.ext_df$distance_m <- seq(0, nrow(transect.ext_df)-1) * res(merged)[1]  # approximate distance if regular
names(transect.ext_df) <- c("elevation", "distance_m")

# Convert distance to km
transect.ext_df$distance_km <- transect.ext_df$distance_m / 1000

# ggplot elevation profile
ggplot(transect.ext_df, aes(x = distance_km, y = elevation)) +
  geom_line(color = "sienna4", linewidth = 1) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +

    y = "Elevation (m)",
    title = "Elevation Transect between Sierra Nevada and White Mountains"
  ) +

    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

```

# Tweaking the plot
Dots for sample sites.
```{r}
points <- data.frame(
  lon = c(-118.255386, -118.687127),
  lat = c(37.634902, 37.223629)
)

# Convert to spatial object and project to match DEM
sites <- vect(points, geom = c("lon", "lat"), crs = "EPSG:4326")
sites <- project(sites, merged)

transect.ext <- terra::extractAlong(merged, line_extended, xy = T) %>% rename(elevation=USGS_13_n37w118_20250514)

# Compute cumulative distance along transect
transect.ext_df <- transect.ext %>%
  mutate(
    # Compute segment distances in meters using geodesic distance
    dist_m = c(0, geosphere::distGeo(cbind(x[-nrow(transect.ext)], y[-nrow(transect.ext)]),
                                     cbind(x[-1], y[-1]))),
    distance_m = cumsum(dist_m),
    distance_km = distance_m / 1000
  )

range(transect.ext_df$distance_km)
# For each site, find closest transect point
site_coords <- crds(sites)

# For each site, find closest point along transect
site_dists <- sapply(1:nrow(site_coords), function(i) {
  which.min(sqrt((transect.ext_df$x - site_coords[i,1])^2 +
                 (transect.ext_df$y - site_coords[i,2])^2))
})
site_points <- transect.ext_df[site_dists, c("distance_km", "elevation")]
site_points$Site <- c("White Mountains", "Piute Pass")
```

```{r}
p <- ggplot(transect.ext_df, aes(x = distance_km, y = elevation)) +
  geom_area(fill = "grey80", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_line(color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(data = site_points,
             aes(x = distance_km, y = elevation, color = Site),
             size = 3,
             show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("White Mountains" = "blue", "Piute Pass" = "red")) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(1000, NA)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    x = "Distance (km)",
    y = "Elevation (m)")+
  scale_x_reverse() + 
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),          # removes all grid lines
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"), # adds simple axes
    panel.border = element_blank()
  )

svg("figures/figures_output/CA_elevation_profile.svg", width=7, heigh=3)
print(p)
dev.off()
```


# Tight elevation plot

```{r}
plot(sites)
ext(sites)

new.sites <- buffer(x = sites, width=15000)

merged.crop <- crop(merged, y=ext(new.sites))

plot(merged.crop)
points(sites)
```
```{r}
merged.crop.df <- as.data.frame(merged.crop, xy=T) %>% rename(elevation=USGS_13_n37w118_20250514)
points
points$site <- c("White Mountains", "Piute Pass")

s <- ggplot()+
  geom_raster(data=merged.crop.df, aes(x=x, y=y, fill=elevation))+
  scale_fill_continuous(low = "grey2", high = "white")+
  geom_point(data=points, aes(x=lon, y=lat, color = site),show.legend = FALSE, size=3)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("White Mountains" = "blue", "Piute Pass" = "red"))+
  theme_minimal(base_size = 20) +  # increases base font size for all text
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold", margin = margin(r = 10)),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 18),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),  # transparent panel
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA)
  )+
  labs(x="Long",
       y="Lat")

plot(s)

png("figures/figures_output/GCRF_sites_elev_plot_trans.png", 
    width = 6.5, height = 5.5, units = "in", res = 600, bg="transparent")
print(s)
dev.off()
```
